take: Per the Jets' announcement, Winnipeg recalled defenseman Henry Thrun from Manitoba (AHL) and placed Dylan DeMelo on injured reserve. DeMelo has played 19.37 minutes a game this season, and the Jets have controlled 46 percent of the quality of chances (expected goals) at 5-on-5 with him on the ice, about 3 points worse than when he sits. Going by how the coach has used his players, Haydn Fleury, now at 12:56 a night, is next in line for DeMelo's second-pair and penalty-kill minutes. We have no numbers on Thrun.
